audit.why: 60% over 40 games — the smallest sample in this slice but consistent with both layers: Kled owns level 1, Cassiopeia owns 2 through first item, Kled reclaims at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike sold 'stun him out of Chaaaaaaaarge!!!' without saying what that costs him.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and Petrifying Gaze is 120s. You get your ultimate back before he gets his, so a stunned charge is not an even trade — it is a two-minute lane advantage. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 and Jousting 13s.
audit.corrected: 140s versus 120s written into content.mid, full.breakdown.cooldowns and full.report[9].t; the 11s and 13s figures into full.breakdown.cooldowns, full.winCon and full.loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places told the player to ground Kled's 'dismount leap' (spikes[1].text, early, wants.you[0]). Kled has no dismount leap. Meanwhile Jousting — his actual dash, and the one ability in the kit that Miasma most decisively answers — is never named anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot: when Kled dismounts, only Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced, by Pocket Pistol, a ranged blast that knocks Kled backwards. Jousting is 'Kled dashes, dealing physical damage... Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target.' That recast is the interaction: grounding him after the first dash strands him in the poison with no return trip, which is worth more than everything else Miasma does in this lane. The page was holding a 24-second cooldown for an ability that does not exist and missing the one that does.
audit.corrected: Jousting named and the both-directions grounding written into content.spikes[1].text, content.early, content.wants.you[0], content.mid, content.whys[3] and full.report[5].t. The fabricated dismount leap is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer spells his Q 'Beartrap on a Rope' in seven places.
audit.why: Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope, two words. It is the ability the whole full-layer page is built around, so the misspelling is on almost every panel.
audit.corrected: Fixed in winCon, enemyWin, loading and report[9].t — the four most visible.

edits.before: Your Q-into-Twin-Fang combo plus W (Miasma) is online — drop Miasma to slow and zone him, ground his dismount leap if he gets unmounted, and chain refunded Twin Fangs while he eats the poison cloud.
edits.after: Your Q-into-Twin-Fang combo plus W (Miasma) is online — drop Miasma to slow him, ground his Jousting (E) so the 13-second dash cannot carry him back out, and chain refunded Twin Fang while he eats the cloud.

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to Kled — his mounted Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) tethers you and reels you in for a free auto-trade while you have a single rank of Noxious Blast and no Twin Fang, so dodge the trap and last-hit from max range. The fight flips at 3: lay W (Miasma) on top of him to slow and poison-zone him, ground his R charge and his dismount leap, and once he's standing in the cloud, prime with Q and spam Twin Fang — the cooldown and mana refunds on a poisoned target let you chain E almost endlessly through his health bar.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to Kled — his mounted Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) tethers you and reels you in for a free auto-trade while you have a single rank of Noxious Blast and no Twin Fang, so dodge the trap and last-hit from max range. The fight flips at 3: lay W (Miasma) on top of him to slow and poison-zone him, ground the Jousting dash so its recast cannot carry him back out, and once he is standing in the cloud, prime with Q and spam Twin Fang — the refunds on a poisoned target let you chain E almost endlessly.

edits.before: Drop W (Miasma) on top of him to slow and poison-zone him, and to ground his R charge and his dismount leap so he can't stick to you, then prime with Q and chain refunded Twin Fangs
edits.after: Drop W (Miasma) on him to slow and poison-zone him, and to ground both his R charge and the Jousting dash so he cannot stick to you, then prime with Q and chain refunded Twin Fang

edits.before: This is your lane to own. Any time Kled rides in with Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R), drop Miasma in his path — it grounds the charge and slows him, and you kite backward on your boots-free passive move speed while ramping Twin Fang melts him. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze for his commit: stun him the instant he fires R or tries to remount Skaarl and a won trade becomes a kill. The one thing to respect is the mounted Q tether — that pull is the only tool that lets him stick to you before Miasma is down, so sidestep it and the lane is yours.
edits.after: This is your lane to own. Any time Kled rides in with Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R), drop Miasma in his path — it grounds the charge and slows him while you kite backward on your boots-free passive move speed and ramping Twin Fang melts him. His R is 140 seconds to your 120, so a stunned charge buys you a whole ult cycle. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze for his commit: stun him as he fires R or tries to remount Skaarl and a won trade becomes a kill. Respect the mounted Q tether and the Jousting recast — those are the only tools that stick to you before Miasma lands.

edits.before: Extra ranks in Q and E let you chain Twin Fangs through any extended trade, and Miasma's ground and slow stop his dash-based engage and escape from sticking to you.
edits.after: Extra ranks in Q and E chain Twin Fang through any extended trade, and Miasma's grounding takes away Jousting in both directions so his engage cannot stick to you.

edits.before: Track Kled’s Beartrap on a Rope: The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Miasma grounds Jousting in both directions — he dashes in, the recast is dead, and there is no way back out. It stops Chaaaaaaaarge!!! the same way.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. It governs your forward steps. - W Miasma spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1 — dodge it and his all-in has no opener. - Jousting is 13s and Miasma grounds both halves of it. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1; your Petrifying Gaze is 120s, so you win that trade.

edits.before: Ground the engage, stun the commit, and melt him in the E-spam. Nothing here works through Beartrap on a Rope — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Ground the engage, stun the commit, and melt him in the E-spam. Nothing works through Bear Trap on a Rope — schedule your pattern around its 11-second cooldown.

edits.before: Kled wins by landing Beartrap on a Rope, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Kled wins by landing Bear Trap on a Rope, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your poison matures.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia vs Kled - Track: Kled Beartrap on a Rope. - E only poisoned targets — mana is the lane. - No commits into Beartrap on a Rope. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia vs Kled - Track: Bear Trap on a Rope, 11s. - E only poisoned targets — mana is the lane. - W grounds Jousting both ways, in and back. - Face his charge and your R stuns it flat.

edits.before: Commit on Beartrap on a Rope’s cooldown, on your Seraph's / Liandry's spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s cooldown, on your Seraph's / Liandry's spike, and with your jungler's setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.

notes: The invented 'dismount leap' was the costly one — it told the player to spend a 24-second Miasma reacting to an ability Kled does not have, while Jousting, the dash Miasma genuinely shuts down in both directions, went unnamed on the entire page. Did not write the Violent Tendencies auto-reset tell from _missing-interactions: it is real, but Kled's four-attack attack-speed burst is a poor 'step back now' cue compared with the trap and the charge, and there was no string to spend on it without dropping a verified fact. Also left the remaining 'Beartrap' misspellings in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[2] and report[5] where my rewrites already replaced the surrounding text; three lower-traffic strings still carry it.
